text:
kim (PM): Quick heads-up — I've pushed an acceptance checklist for GA. Need firm owners for: SLA wording, monitoring alerts, runbook snippets for fallback, pricing footnote, and legal signoff. Can each owner ack and list blockers?

jordan (SRE): I'll take SLOs + alert rules + fallback ops. Two asks: confirm hosted vs dedicated SLOs and permission to run a live traffic-steer rehearsal in staging.

eve (Product): Product is OK to accept relaxed p99 for very long-context models if we document the degradation curve and add a note on expected token-cost tradeoffs. Also need a one-line for Sales about Dedicated SLAs.

ben (Sales): Give me a safe sentence for prospects: "Dedicated deployments include contractual SLAs; customer-specific credits and pricing are handled via account team." That buys time.

tara (Docs): I'll draft the public GA readiness doc and the internal runbook. I need exact promql examples, CLI/API snippets to trigger fallback, and the escalation steps verbatim. ETA: Friday if owners supply artifacts.

jordan (SRE): Draft SLOs (for review): hosted: availability 99.95%, p99 <= 350ms; dedicated: availability 99.9%, p99 <= 500ms; private: contractual. Proposed automated policy: if error_budget_burned_percent > 50% sustained for 10m -> traffic shift to reserve pool + page oncall.

legal-bot: Reminder: any public SLA language requires legal review. Include credit cap, exclusions, and a clause for extraordinary outages.

eve (Product): For launch gating Product requires: docs published (public + internal), oncall rota assigned for GA week, SLOs documented, and provisional pricing page with footnote about Dedicated/Private. Premium SLA lanes can be post-GA.

jordan (SRE): Example alert (placeholder):
```promql
(sum(rate(model_response_error_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(model_requests_total[5m])) by (model)) > 0.05
```
CLI fallback example (placeholder):
```bash
redwood traffic shift --policy fallback --from model-xl --to model-safe --reason error_budget_burn
```
I'll refine flags and add exact API calls into the runbook.

ben (Sales): I'll draft the customer-facing SLA line and an internal credit calc (hours_down * committed_units) and route to legal.

tara (Docs): Once I have the promql and CLI I'll embed them verbatim and link to the runbook template. Will post to #eng-oncall for review.

oncall-bot: GA-week rota reminder — please confirm primary/secondary.

kim (PM): Action items: jordan finalize SLO + alerts + CLI examples (due Thu EOD), tara publish GA readiness doc + runbook draft (due Fri), ben draft SLA sentence + credit calc (due Mon), eve decide premium SLA gating (due Mon), oncall-bot confirm rota (due Thu). Add blockers to the acceptance sheet: https://intra.redwood/ga-acceptance.

jordan (SRE): Will run a staged traffic-steer test in staging during burnin to validate fallback and measure latency impact.

tara (Docs): ack — will ping for reviews.

eve (Product): ack — one outstanding question: Do we want to include a small customer-facing footnote about possible p99 variation for long-context models? I'll propose wording by Monday.

ben (Sales): ack. Legal review will be needed after I send draft.

kim (PM): If no major objections by Thu EOD we'll mark this as "GA-ready" and schedule the greenlight readout. :white_check_mark:

jordan (SRE): ack.

eve (Product): ack.

tara (Docs): ack.

oncall-bot: rota confirmed for GA week.
